records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating revenues increased 24.0% for the three months ended March 31, 2022, compared to the same period of the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our One-Way Truckload fleet experienced strong freight demand in January and February, which then moderated in March from strong to very good, relative to March freight demand over the last five years.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Strong consumer demand, combined with several factors that are limiting industry capacity, including a very competitive driver market and ongoing new tractor production delays, resulted in a robust first quarter freight market.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in average revenues per tractor was due primarily to improved pricing in both Dedicated and One-Way Truckload, offset by a decline in miles per tractor caused by fleet mix changes, tractors down due to equipment parts shortages, more drivers unavailable to work due to COVID quarantine protocols and other factors.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Werner Logistics operating margin percentage of 4.6% in first quarter 2022 increased from 3.3%, while operating income increased to $8.7 million.
